invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Option<HoodieRollbackPlan> because Option is generally used as a non-null wrapper.
instantTime is always passed to the underlying executor and is expected to be non-null for rollback scheduling.
instantToRollback is required and passed to the executor; rollback logic depends on a concrete instant.
context is required for parallel/engine operations, and base methods in the codebase rely on it being non-null.
